text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan hasn't been herself lately,
so we go
to a shrine together.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Do you know the rules? You're supposed
to bow
before passing through the torii
gate, and you're
also meant to avoid
walking down the middle of
the path.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
When you pray, you need to bow twice,
clap
twice, and then bow again. And the
bows ought
to be ninety degrees. For
the offering, I brought
some shiny new
five-yen coins.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. I've been conversing with the
gods
regularly since I was young, so I
know the rules
like the back of my hand.
After all...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There's something I've been praying for
since
before I even set my sights on
enrolling at Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Young Machan
text_block_list.text:
I pray that someday I can become a
mascot that
everyone will remember.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And it was after that that I first
encountered an
Umamusume mascot
doll. Ever since that day, I've
kept my
shrine etiquette on point—and never

broken a single rule.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
O gods, lend me your assistance. Please
give me
the power to stay healthy and
bright.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Perfect. Now I have peace of mind, I can
focus on
working hard.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, things are getting out of hand...

New merchandising ideas have been
coming to
me nonstop since yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I feel so motivated I want to jump up
and click my
heels.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'd better go back to the shrine
and give
thanks where it's due.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I keep trying to think of new
merch ideas,
but nothing's coming to
me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's slump continues for
some time.
